The workflow also moved to env-indirected arguments in 01b0449.
The retirement scan is now per-line, case-insensitive and order-independent (copilot AND review in the same line), so a Copilot-as-reviewer instruction cannot slip through by word order.

dispositions.reason: The controller is deliberately forge-free and resolves every commit in the control home's object DB (the same assumption as BUILD_GREEN commit_sha and MERGED merged_sha). The required CI check is the forge-anchored layer: it compares the record head against github.event.pull_request.head.sha. Adding a per-story code-repo parameter is a controller-contract change outside this slice's boundary.
dispositions.evidence: controllers checks: BUILD_GREEN `commit_exists(self.root, sha)`; MERGE_ELIGIBLE `head_sha_resolves` (added 01b0449); architecture §Review lane Required check paragraph states the two-layer split.
REVIEWING now requires SHA_RE.fullmatch(review_head_sha) before the prefix comparison; empty/non-hex evidence fails with a named detail.
ci_gate duplicate-slot guard covered by a new fixture asserting the 'duplicate reviewer slots' refusal.
New ci_gate test runs the bare workflow invocation (default --records-root and --panel) and passes against the committed panel.
New ci_gate fixture renders WITH --package-manifest, deletes the package file, and passes at the exact head and a record-tail head.
manifest contract/gate specs are now repo-relative only (absolute or `..` refused at render and check); rebuild resolves them under the repo after a containment check.
validate-doc now uses --repo to resolve a relative --package path; a foreign-cwd test pins the behaviour.
record_head is validated with SHA_RE before the head comparison.
Workflow passes PR_NUMBER and HEAD_SHA through the job env and quotes them in the shell; no ${{ }} expansion in the run block.

dispositions.reason: The declared panel is repository policy, not a universal controller constant. The required CI check enforces it via ci_gate.panel_slot_errors against kit-v0.1/review-panel.toml; the generic controller enforces panel symmetry through the record authority (check_panel_symmetry). Imposing a kit-specific panel file on every target repo would break the controller's repo-agnostic contract.
dispositions.evidence: ci_gate.py panel_slot_errors + review-panel.toml; record.py check_panel_symmetry (v2 records).
